fields.name: placeholder
fields.label: Prompt Text
fields.description: Shown inside the empty input, e.g. "Ask us about transformational AI". Also used as the input's label for screen readers.

fields.name: link
fields.label: Answer Page
fields.description: Page that answers the question. The question is sent as ?q=… Leave empty to stay on the current page.

fields.name: suggestions
fields.label: Suggested Questions
fields.description: Optional. A bulleted list; each item becomes a chip that asks that question.
